jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
What we want to accomplish and why we need you

Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions.  Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we’re striving to do even better. Come and join us!

We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctor. We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. Check out this short video to learn more about our mission and our culture.

About the Role:

As Technical Program Manager, your primary role is to drive the successful technical integration of Suki with our major health system and health technology clients.  You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, and ensuring that Suki’s integration delivers exceptionally well on key success metrics.  You will partner with your Suki colleagues to optimize on-time delivery and resolve technical challenges. Throughout each client deployment, you will guide technical stakeholders through the steps needed to establish a seamless integration between Suki and their EMR.

Besides guiding the integration process, this individual will be responsible for testing the integration and green-lighting each integration stage, escalating issues when needed. As Suki’s resident expert on its integrations, you will establish and maintain internal and external-facing documentation detailing the integration requirements and process for each EMR with which Suki integrates. Partnering with a Customer Success team member, you will be the technical point person for each integration and as the client-facing technical resource, set expectations for the client to identify and engage with the technical resources necessary for a successful integration with their EMR. Internally, this entails close collaboration with Engineering to solve technical challenges and develop/maintain robust test plans which will support proactive discovery and resolution for potential issues before go-live. Similarly, this individual will also be tightly aligned with Product to share new EMR constraints, gaps and learnings that will help keep our products up to date. You will also educate your Suki colleagues on each integration’s best practices, requirements, and key points of differentiation.

You will collaborate extensively with our Customer Success, Product, Engineering & Support teams and serve as the voice of the customer by reporting on the status of deployments and potential technical issues. You will also identify areas for optimization in Suki’s integration process.

As part of our growing Customer Success team, you will also be responsible for improving existing processes and developing new approaches to create high levels of client and user satisfaction.  You will also engage with EMR vendor partners and Suki’s Engineering and Product teams to streamline the technical integration between Suki and EMRs for both existing and future capabilities. You are excited to join the fast-moving Suki team, and committed to excellence!

Responsibilities and expectations include but are not limited to:

  • Program Management: Establish and maintain deployment project plans, ensure cross-functional resources required to support deployments are in place, regularly report on deployment progress, and escalate potential issues. You will also identify opportunities for improvement in the deployment project plan and drive process improvements to achieve on-time delivery and high client satisfaction, including but not limited to establishing escalation roles and responsibilities.
  • Technical Skill: You will need to have an understanding of SDLC and become an expert in our products and their integrations. You will also know how to establish and drive repeatable and efficient processes for integrating with our customers’ EMRs and our partners’ platforms.
  • Leadership: You will drive action in cross-functional settings and influence stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Integration Subject Matter Expert (SME): You will need to develop a deep understanding of our product and how it integrates with our customers’ EMRs and partners’ platforms.  You will be able to translate that into education to our enterprise clients and platform partners.
  • Organization: Utilize JIRA for issue reporting, status, escalation, and task management in collaboration with the Engineering team.
  • Executive-Level Presence and Communications: Ability to communicate both internally and externally with professionalism in person, on video, on the phone, and over email with C-level executives, providers and colleagues.
  • Adaptability:  You thrive in a fast-moving organization that uses light-weight processes and cutting-edge technology to have a huge impact.
  • High-Accountability: You can be counted on to consistently deliver high-quality work.
  • User-focused: You are obsessed with the customer experience. You can translate key consumer needs into business and product requirements. You have an innate understanding of user behavior, and ensure users are receiving 100% quality service.
  • Detail Oriented: You need a high degree of attention to small details along with the ability to quickly iterate on our deployment playbooks and processes.
  • Travel: You are willing to travel as needed to deliver and validate our integrations.
  • Flexibility: You will need to work flexible hours based upon client’s and providers’ schedules in different time zones across the US.

Requirements:*

  • 8+ years of enterprise customer facing experience within healthcare SaaS
  • 5+ years of technical program or project management experience
  • Technical understanding of software development kits (SDKs), cloud services, EMR integration and SaaS solutions
  • Strong knowledge of APIs and healthcare data standards
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively and communicate expediently
  • Creative problem solving skills
  • Strong clinical background with understanding of medical documentation and clinical workflows
  • Proficient in Google Suite, JIRA

\* Requirements is such a strong word.  We don’t necessarily expect to find a candidate that has done everything listed, but you should be able to make a credible case that you’ve done most of it and are ready for the challenge of adding some new things to your resume.

Tell me more about Suki

  • On a roll: Named by Fast Company as one of the most innovative companies, named Google’s Partner of the Year for AI/ML, named by Forbes as one of the top 50 companies in AI .
  • Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful tech veterans from Google and Apple and medical leaders from UCSF and Stanford. We have technologists and doctors working side-by-side to solve complex problems.
  • Great investors: We’re backed by Venrock, First Round Capital, Flare Capital, March Capital, Hedosophia and others. With our $165M raised so far, we have the resources to scale.
  • Huge market: Disrupting a massive, growing $30+ billion market for transcription, dictation, and order-entry solutions. Our vision is to become the voice user interface for healthcare, relieving the administrative burden on doctors instead of adding to it.
  • Great customers: Our solutions are used in health systems and clinics across the country, supporting clinicians across dozens of specialties.  Check out what one of our users says about how Suki has helped his practice.
  • Impact: You’ll make an impact from day one. You’ll join a team working towards a shared purpose with a culture built upon deep empathy for doctors and passion for making their lives better.

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way, and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.

In compliance with the State of California Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is between $150000 - $180000 in CA.  This range is not inclusive of any annual variable targets, discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About the role

At Going, data is our core product driver and a product in its own right. Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) is the team that runs it like an internal platform business: your product is the unified stream of flight data; your customers are our internal product and feature teams, and your ultimate end-users are millions of subscribers who rely on us for timely, hyper-relevant flight deals.

We’re hiring a systems-thinking Senior Technical Product Manager to lead a cross-functional team of senior Data and Backend Engineers. You’ll own the charter and roadmap for how Going acquires, pipelines, and engineers high-quality datasets that power Going’s core products. This requires building the resilience and diversification that reduces our dependence on any single data source, and turning that data into a product every downstream team can build on without re-solving it themselves. You’ll report to the VP of Product.

In the short term, you will

  • Take ownership of the product data acquisition strategy and data processing roadmap; supporting the parallel build of a new system to replace the current

  • Establish baseline measurement across our data funnel — coverage, pipeline health, and data quality — so future architecture and business decisions are based on value and cost

  • Drive architecture that enables efficiency — a single-record architecture that’s durable and observable

  • Make data usable, not just available — You’ll push toward a dynamic system that learns and adapts based on market trends and real consumer demand

  • Serve internal customers so downstream teams have one trusted source to build against

In the long term, you will

  • Build Going’s long-term data acquisition strategy — diversified, cost-efficient, and resilient to any single vendor’s disruption

  • Turn our data caching and curation layer into a plug-and-play foundation that can onboard any future data source

  • Make the data platform the compounding advantage behind Going’s product — the thing every team builds on, not a shared dependency people work around

What you know

Required:

  • You’re legally authorized to work in the United States and able to work US-hours.

  • 5–8+ years of product management experience, with significant time owning data platform, data infrastructure, or data products

  • Systems & Data Fluency: Comfort reading API specs, writing SQL, working with complex JSON/XML schemas, and discussing architecture (ETL/ELT pipelines, caching strategies, data lineage and provenance, metadata management) with senior engineers as peers

  • Exposure to data quality, normalization, or golden dataset patterns

  • Experience establishing measurement baselines before re-architecting or setting targets — you diagnose before you build

  • Comfortable owning vendor/supplier relationships and contract negotiation, including cost-vs-coverage tradeoffs

  • Track record navigating ambiguity while still shipping durable, well-governed systems

  • Clear, async-first communicator — comfortable setting direction for a dedicated engineering team while working across technical and non-technical partners

Preferred:

  • Travel/aviation data expertise: GDS feeds, OAG/Cirium APIs, fare buckets and cabin mapping, IATA/ICAO codes

  • Prior experience designing internal data products or operating within a Data Mesh architecture.

  • Prior experience designing internal data products or operating in a data mesh model

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, low-latency edge caching, and scaling systems for real-time demand spikes.

Benefits & Perks you’ll love…

  • The salary for this role starts at $175,000 + equity

  • 100% remote work environment

  • Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City.

  • Open vacation policy, with a 15-day minimum

  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance

  • 401(k) with a 5% match

  • $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend

  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave

  • Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co-worker

  • Continuing education & development reimbursement

  • Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day

We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status. Going is an E-Verify employer.

‍If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance for any part of the interview and employment process, please contact us at careers@going.com and let us know the nature of your request.

As the trusted provider to over 22,000 enterprise locations worldwide, our mission is to help our clients connect and communicate easily. We aim to delight our customers and partners by providing personalized, outstanding service.

The company has built a solid reputation of integrity, reliability and dependability with its channel partners, end-user customers and technology partners.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate / Manager (Vertical AI B2B - Hybrid)
jobs.jd_full:
About Momos

Momos is building AI agents for unforgettable hospitality. Our agents power the end-to-end guest experience for some of the largest hospitality brands in the world, including Burger King and Popeyes—helping them understand their guests, resolve issues, strengthen relationships, and improve operations across thousands of locations.

We are an international company backed by leading global investors, and we are growing quickly.

Vietnam is at the center of that growth. We are building what we call our AI Village: a dense community of exceptionally smart, hungry, and AI-native people who want to build category-defining products together. Vietnam is already our largest and fastest-growing office. It is not a satellite office or an outsourced delivery center—it is a core part of Momos’ global strategy and where many of our most important teams and capabilities are being built.

About the role

We are looking for a heat-seeking missile for pain.

This is not a role with a neat box around it. You will go wherever the company’s hardest and most important problems are, figure out what is actually happening, and help solve them.

One month, you might launch a new operating process or help us enter a market. The next, you might diagnose why a key metric is underperforming, build the business case for a new initiative, unblock a cross-functional project, or turn a messy spreadsheet and five competing opinions into a clear decision.

You do not need to come from one specific background. You might be an ex-consultant, banker, business analyst, product manager, startup operator, or simply an unusually capable generalist. We care less about the label on your previous job than whether you can think clearly, learn quickly, use AI fluently, and take complete ownership of difficult problems.

This role is for someone who wants to eat, sleep, and breathe startups—not someone looking for a predictable lane or a perfectly defined job description.

What you’ll do

  • Find the highest-impact problems across the company and drive them through to resolution.
  • Break ambiguous questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and executable plans.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning product, go-to-market, finance, customer operations, and international expansion.
  • Build the models, dashboards, processes, and operating rhythms needed to help Momos scale.
  • Work closely with company leadership to evaluate opportunities and make important decisions.
  • Use AI aggressively to research, analyze, automate, prototype, and move faster.
  • Step into operational gaps when something important does not yet have a clear owner.

Experience

  • Associate: 1–3 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking or private equity, a business or product analyst role, or an operating role at a high-growth startup
  • Manager: 4–6 years in the same backgrounds, with a track record of owning ambiguous, cross-functional projects end-to-end and presenting directly to senior leadership — not just supporting someone else’s initiative

Core skills

  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Advanced Excel, plus working comfort with at least one data/BI tool (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in day-to-day work — research, analysis, automation, or prototyping
  • Strong analytical thinking combined with a bias toward action

You might be a fit if

  • You are relentlessly resourceful and naturally gravitate toward difficult, messy problems.
  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a bias toward action.
  • You can move comfortably between strategy, data, process, and hands-on execution.
  • You communicate clearly and can bring structure to people with different perspectives.
  • You learn unusually quickly and do not need extensive instructions before getting started.
  • You hold a high bar for your own work and are willing to do whatever the problem requires.
  • You are genuinely excited about AI and already use it to improve how you think and work.
  • You want to build in person alongside an ambitious team in Vietnam.
  • You have experience in consulting, banking, business analysis, product, operations, or a high-growth startup—or can demonstrate equivalent horsepower through another path.

What success looks like

Within your first year, you will have solved several problems that materially changed how Momos operates or grows. You will become someone leadership and teams trust with the company’s most important, ambiguous, and cross-functional challenges.

The scope and level of the role—Associate or Manager—will be calibrated to the experience and capabilities of the person we hire.

Why Join Momos?

  • Mission-driven, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • Collaborative, flat company culture
  • Comprehensive private health insurance
  • Discretionary trips to our offices worldwide, with global travel medical coverage
  • Cross-cultural team bonding and networking

Equal Opportunity

Momos is an equal-opportunity workplace that embraces diversity and different cultures. We started as an international company and know that building an organization with diverse experiences, perspectives, and opinions allows our team to grow and excel.

Love Food? Join our Team!

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you’re looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the Role

As a Program Manager on the Operations team (part of the Tech Org.), you will be responsible for the end-to-end success of our customer partnerships ensuring success during the launch of each integration. You will build strong relationships across our retail partners’ organization from senior stakeholders to management and team members on the ground. You will have the opportunity to lead cross-functional technical projects with Afresh stakeholders and successfully deploy our solution at scale while continuously improving our processes that are fast-paced and constantly evolving.

You have customer-facing experience, are structured and have strong project management skills, and love driving projects to completion in a fast-paced environment; you are excited to reduce fresh food waste in the grocery industry, too!

Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute successful integrations with our partners
  • Deeply understand our customers’ operations and how the Afresh solution maps to these to provide maximum value
  • Create detailed, actionable implementation plans that enable both Afresh and our customers to understand and execute on the full scope of our deployment processes
  • Build trusted relationships with our partners’ point people including project management, store teams, operation leads, and executive teams
  • Lead cross-functional work across Afresh’s teams to manage the deployment process and build consensus, including work with our Executive, Engineering, Product, Support, Account and Sales teams
  • Capture learnings and best practices from deployment efforts to create a sustainable, replicable playbook for future deployments
  • Identify and implement ways to improve Afresh & our team’s processes as we build our work together
  • Continually work towards scaling our processes and solutions to achieve a lower cost to serve

Attributes

  • Exceptional project management skills to keep multiple complex projects spanning many external and internal stakeholders on track simultaneously
  • Customer empathy and ability to build meaningful relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders at our customers
  • Self-reliance to source answers and make informed but new decisions
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and charting the right path forward
  • Effective cross-functional collaboration, including the ability to clearly communicate needs and rally support
  • Process improvement mindset and a desire to move the needle on how we do the work we do, to improve both customer outcomes and cost to serve
  • Understanding of customer business processes, and ability to utilize expertise and appropriate product functionalities to address customer issues
  • Commercial mindset that allows you to understand and act on what our customers care about most

What skills or experience do you need?

The following represent attributes our ideal candidate possesses. We encourage all highly-qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not fulfill all the listed criteria.

  • 5+ years experience managing client relationships
  • 3+ years experience in product implementations/deployments (SaaS preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to drive projects to completion
  • Experience in grocery or retail industry preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency working with AI models such as Claude, Codex, Replit or other tools
  • Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Looker or other dashboarding tools preferred
  • Open to travel (up to 25%)

This position is not eligible for sponsorship

Salary Range in US: $134K - $181K + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh

At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and “Coworking Wallets” for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for “Betterment” (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.

* Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt’s Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states: AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA, UT, VA, WI.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

  • Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.
  • Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.
  • Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.
  • Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.
  • Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.
  • Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).

Job Title: Program Manager

Location: Knoxville, TN (Preferred). Candidates local to the Knoxville, TN area are preferred to support onsite collaboration; however, qualified candidates located in the Washington, DC area will also be considered for remote work arrangements.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Who We Are

Management Solutions, LLC (MSLLC) is an award-winning management consulting firm delivering solutions for our partners’ most complex challenges. Since 2002, we have supported federal and commercial clients through expertise in project and program strategy, delivery and implementation, engineering and technical advisory services, workforce solutions, and digital solutions.

We are distinguished by our reputation for managing mission-critical projects and helping organizations improve performance through innovative, people-centered solutions. MSLLC has been recognized as Small Business of the Year by the U.S. Small Business Administration, the Department of Energy, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory and has been named one of the Top Employers in the Greater Knoxville area.

Why Join Our Team

At Management Solutions, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and caring culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow. We seek professionals who think critically, solve complex problems, and are dedicated to building and sustaining high-performing, client-focused solutions.

Position Overview

The Program Manager is responsible for providing program and project management oversight across complex client initiatives across multiple, large federal defense programs while supporting requirements analysis, operational planning, pricing activities, and financial performance. This client-facing role serves as a key partner to leadership, project teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful execution of program objectives, alignment of resources, and delivery of high-quality solutions.

The Program Manager will oversee program performance by monitoring schedules, risks, deliverables, project financials, and resource utilization across multiple initiatives. This role requires the ability to analyze technical direction, client requirements, and project objectives to develop actionable plans, support pricing and cost estimating efforts, and maintain visibility into program performance through forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of program management, business analysis, project financial management, and stakeholder engagement experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive projects from planning through execution in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

This role involves executing both program-level management and oversight as well as project-level execution support.

Program Management:

  • Lead and oversee program execution across multiple projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.

  • Serve as a primary client-facing point of contact, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and facilitating clear communication across teams.

  • Build trust with the client and cultivate a strong relationship to drive the relationship from MSLLC being a “safe pair of hands” to a “trusted advisor.”

  • Work closely with MSLLC’s Account and Relationship Leads to ensure program performance is on budget and meeting revenue and profitability targets, as well as identifying potential opportunities for account growth.

  • Develop a growth plan strategy for the program, in connection with the MSLLC Account and Relationship Leads. Pressure test key assumptions to ensure realistic achievement and coordinate across the team to determine the most viable pathways for growth.

  • Liaise with MSLLC Functional Managers (as needed) to ensure the appropriate personnel are delivered across projects.

Project Execution:

  • Analyze project requirements, technical direction, and client needs to develop actionable plans and support successful project execution.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to support program priorities, resource alignment, and operational execution.

  • Monitor and analyze project performance, schedules, risks, resource utilization, and financial metrics, providing recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Support pricing and cost estimation activities, ensuring accurate forecasting, financial visibility, and alignment with project requirements.

  • Track project expenditures, burn rates, and forecasts across multiple projects to support financial stability and informed decision-making.

  • Generate timely and accurate program and financial reports, including weekly and monthly status updates, to maintain visibility into performance, risks, and milestones.

  • Support development and review of project execution plans (PEPs), project documentation, and proposal-related materials to ensure alignment with client requirements and contractual expectations.

  • Collaborate closely with project managers, leadership, and contract teams to assess funding needs, resource allocation, and project execution strategies.

  • Identify program risks, financial impacts, dependencies, and operational challenges, proactively developing mitigation strategies.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, internal processes, and applicable regulations while maintaining accurate project documentation and reporting.

  • Facilitate meetings, briefings, and presentations with internal and external stakeholders to communicate priorities, recommendations, and program status.

  • Manage multiple priorities and support geographically dispersed teams in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Project Management, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, business analysis, financial analysis, project controls, management consulting, or other related consulting/program delivery environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex projects or programs involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-functional coordination, with experience managing federal defense programs preferred.

  • Experience analyzing project requirements, technical direction, scope, or client needs and translating them into actionable plans and deliverables.

  • Experience supporting pricing, cost estimating, budgeting, forecasting, burn rate management, or financial reporting for projects or programs.

  • Experience monitoring program performance, schedules, risks, deliverables, and financial metrics to support successful project execution.

  • Ability to interpret and support proposal documentation, project execution plans (PEPs), statements of work (SOWs), technical direction, or similar project documentation.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, leadership, and technical teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments and adapt to changing business needs.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across project teams, leadership, contracts, and operational stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills for tracking, reporting, and financial analysis.

  • Ability to obtain a federal government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP certification or equivalent project/program management certification.

  • Experience supporting federal government contracts, including familiarity with government project environments, reporting requirements, or compliance expectations, ideally within defense or intelligence agencies.

  • Experience with Technical Direction Letters (TDLs), project execution plans (PEPs), pricing proposals, cost estimating, or project financial management.

  • Familiarity with FAR and DFARS regulations, including experience supporting compliance requirements in government contracting environments.

  • Experience supporting federal program financial oversight, including forecasting, variance analysis, subcontractor tracking, labor planning, or resource allocation.

  • Experience working within a management consulting or professional services environment.

  • Experience leading or supporting geographically dispersed teams and client-facing programs.

  • Graduate degree preferred.

Work Authorization: U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract and/or security clearance requirements.

Working Conditions: This position is primarily performed in an office environment or a home office setting. Employees will be required to use a computer and other office equipment for extended periods. Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and operate a computer and standard office equipment.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Management Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) is the Law.

Management Solutions is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Human Resources.

Disclaimer:

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not a complete list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with it.

Management Solutions LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Tailscale-Native Apps
jobs.jd_full:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We’re building a future for the Internet that’s easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we’re backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own what it’s like to build a Tailscale-native application — software with Tailscale connectivity and identity built in from the start.

You’d own the original front door to that world: TSNet, the Go library that puts a Tailscale node inside an application in a few lines of code; tailscale-rs, our new Rust-based SDK family (including C++, Python, and Elixir); the tailscale CLI powering scripting, automation, and CI; and the core Tailscale client library.

Products already get built this way, inside and outside Tailscale. Aperture, our AI connectivity gateway, and Tailscale PAM run on these primitives. So do LM Studio, NVIDIA, and Namespace.co, who embed Tailscale directly into their applications to give their users secure remote access, reach into customer networks safely, and bridge cloud environments without VPN gymnastics. One of those teams went from zero to a working embedded integration in hours. Your job is to make that the normal outcome for thousands of more applications.

Today this experience is engineering-led and the developer journey is uneven. The API is powerful, but the on-ramp from “I read a blog post” to “Tailscale is running inside my product” has real friction: auth key handling, onboarding flows designed for humans instead of embedded apps, docs and examples that don’t yet tell a coherent story. You’ll own that journey end to end and define, concretely, what it means to build a Tailscale-native application including the golden paths, the reference patterns, the APIs, and the developer experience that makes people say “wait, that’s all it took?”

You’ll report to Ross Kukulinski, VP Product, and work closely with the Rust, Golang, and Clients engineering teams, plus the internal product teams and external partners building Tailscale-Native Applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for the native apps experience: TSNet, tailscale-rs, and the tailscale CLI
  • Define what “Tailscale-native application” means — the reference architectures, golden paths, and embedding patterns, packaged as docs, examples, and sample apps developers can build from
  • Own the developer experience end to end: the on-ramp from blog post to running embedded node, API ergonomics, error messages, docs that work, examples that compile, and upgrade paths that don’t burn early adopters
  • Set the Rust SDK family strategy: which TSNet capabilities to port, which to skip, in what order, and how to position the library to developers.
  • Treat the CLI as a product in its own right: scripting ergonomics, output conventions, automation surfaces, and the experience for platform and SRE teams running tailscale in CI and infrastructure-as-code
  • Run the internal dogfood loop. Aperture and Tailscale PAM are built on these primitives; make those teams your most demanding customers and turn their friction into roadmap.
  • Partner with GTM and Customer Success on embedding deals — AI platforms, developer tools, and infrastructure software shipping Tailscale inside their products — and let what you learn set priorities
  • Engage developers where they live (GitHub issues, Discord, office hours) and build a coherent picture of what embedded developers need

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years in product management, or a software engineering background moving into product, with real time spent on a developer-facing product: an SDK, API, CLI, library, or developer tool
  • You’ve shipped developer-facing features that developers used in production, and lived with the consequences of your design choices — naming, defaults, error behavior, versioning
  • You can read Go and/or Rust and hold a credible technical conversation about API and SDK design
  • You have taste in developer experience: opinions about API ergonomics, docs, error messages, and getting-started flows, with examples to back them up
  • You do customer research the way developer products require it — reading GitHub issues, lurking in Discord, running office hours, and finding the pattern in the noise
  • You turn ambiguous scope into shipped increments, close the loop after launch, and keep teams informed along the way

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on Go or Rust experience — you’ve built something real, even as a side project
  • Time at a developer platform company with a strong SDK motion (e.g. Stripe, Twilio, Auth0, Vercel, Supabase, HashiCorp)
  • Open-source community experience: contributor experience, issue triage, balancing commercial priorities with community needs
  • Enough networking, zero-trust, or VPN familiarity to understand what embedding Tailscale does for a developer
  • Experience designing CLIs or scripting surfaces for platform and SRE teams
  • Public technical writing, talks, OSS contributions, or developer-tooling side projects
  • LLMs and coding agents as part of your daily product workflow

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale’s compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire’s base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range

$177,000—$221,000 USD

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).
